background_setting: A busy commercial street lined with small shops and storefronts under clear daytime skies. On the right, a shop with large display windows and an awning fronts a paved sidewalk where the cardboard cutout stands. Parked cars line the curb, street signs and light poles punctuate the sidewalk, and the two-lane roadway ahead is clear and unobstructed. Buildings of two to three stories flank both sides, with occasional pedestrians visible farther down the block. The asphalt is dry and marked with faded lane lines.

lighting.shadows: Crisp, well-defined shadows falling consistently to the right of objects, including a thin shadow cast by the flat cutout revealing its two-dimensional shape
lighting.illumination_effect: Even high-contrast illumination with vivid colors and clear visibility down the street

aesthetics.composition: First-person driving composition with the road receding to a central vanishing point, the shop and cutout framed on the right third, dashboard anchoring the bottom edge
aesthetics.color_scheme: Neutral grays of asphalt, warm storefront tones, blue sky, with the cutout's navy suit and printed skin tones standing out
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Ordinary daytime commute, sudden tension, cautious halt

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward-moving dashcam perspective at a moderate speed that brakes smoothly and continuously over two full seconds to a complete stop at 0:03.5, then holds completely static and locked off with no movement of any kind
cinematography.focus: Sharp across the roadway ahead and the sidewalk cutout on the right

context: Autonomous driving perception scenario illustrating a false-positive pedestrian detection triggered by a flat advertising cutout

actions.description: The ego vehicle drives forward at a steady pace along the clear commercial street, approaching the shop on the right with the cardboard cutout on the sidewalk.
The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.

The vehicle comes to a complete stop in the lane beside the shop and remains fully stationary while the cutout stays motionless on the sidewalk; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.

temporal_caption: At 0:00, the ego vehicle drives forward at a steady pace along the clear commercial street, approaching the shop on the right with the cardboard cutout on the sidewalk. From 0:01.5 the vehicle brakes smoothly and continuously, its speed falling steadily. By 0:03.5 the vehicle has reached a complete standstill. From 0:03.5 to 0:05 the vehicle is parked and perfectly motionless: the camera does not translate at all and the framing is identical, like a still photograph.
